book.name: MULUM PASA
book.title: MULUM PASA Kuate tuku mulum pasa Mosesŋge kuyarna

content: Suŋgo nu siŋka pasa saŋgrinu Abram sana
Mara ande Suŋgo nu Abram sana: Ne naŋe kilke naŋe tumbraŋ tuguk naŋe ndare kusreka ye ma ande tumni le ne ka kilke ta mbolŋge mina.
Yeŋge ki le ne tuku ndare tugeka taŋgo kuasmbi suŋgokanu mayok kaŋgat. Yeŋge ne nyaro tini le ne taŋgo suŋgo nyu ŋak minamŋgat. Taŋawa le nane ŋgumneŋga ne tuku saka nane afu nyaro niŋge likamŋgaig.
Nane afu ne nyaro tinwaig ta ye mata nane nyaro niŋgamŋgit. Ko nane afu ne kasurnuwaig ta ye mata nane kasurniŋgamŋgit. Ne mbolŋge ye kilke tugu ŋakmba mbolŋge wam mayenu kamŋgit ŋgina.
Suŋgo nu taŋakina le Abram nu miŋge dubimba tiŋga Haran tumbraŋ kusremba kina le Lot nu dubimba kina. Ait ta mbolŋge Abram nu yar 75 ŋak minna.
Abram nu kumba piyo nuŋe Sarai, nzamu nuŋe Lot, Haran mbal afu nu piyaniŋmba kilna ta agaŋ ndende ŋakmba kilmba Kanan kambim saka kinaig kumba ka ka Kanan kilke mbol pronaig.
Pronaig sulumba kilke ŋgamu fetka kumba ka Sekem ma promba More ma tuku ail suŋgo ta tugumŋge minnaig. Ait ta mbolŋge Kanan mbal nane kilke ta mbolŋge mine likinaig.

Minnaig le Suŋgo nu Abram tugum promba sana: Ye ne tuku ndare kilke te siŋka serniŋgamŋgit ŋgina. Taŋakina le Abram nu Suŋgo nu teŋge ye tugum prowat ŋga ndame afu kilmba turŋaŋga atraukam tuku pa laŋlaŋ inum wakeina.

Taŋana sulumba nu ma ta kusremba kina ka tabe ande poŋga baibai patika taŋge minnaig. Tabe ta Betel tumbraŋ ki butuŋgate kumam Ai tumbraŋ ki prote kumam nu ŋgamuŋge minna. Tabe mbol taŋge Abram nu ndame turŋaŋga Suŋgo atraukam tuku pa laŋlaŋ wakeimba Suŋgo mbariŋmba nu tuku nyu te-duŋga minna.
Taŋana sulumba nu maŋ tiŋga kumba ka Negeb ma baknu ta kambim saka kina. Negeb ma baknu ta Kanan kilke mbolŋge minit.
Abram nu Isip kilke mbol kina
Nu kina ta Negeb kilke mbolŋge guba suŋgo prona tukunu Abram nane gubak minnaig sulumba ndeka kilke ta kusremba Isip kilke mbol ndekinaig.
Ndekinaig sulumba Isip kilke mbol prowam bafumba nu piyo nuŋe Sarai sana: Ne pino tumail pasi ŋgarosu mayenu ndo.
Isip taŋgo kame nane ne kaŋgernumba nuŋe piyo nuŋe ŋga idusmba ne tam tuku ye baleyumba ne kusrenamŋgaig.
Ta tuku taŋgo te ye tuku leu ŋga saniŋga le nane ne tuku ŋga ye bale ndayuwaig le ye maye minamŋgit ŋga Sarai sana.
Taŋakina sulumba Abram nu Isip kilke mbol prona le Isip mbal mambilmba Sarai kaŋgermba pino ta mayenu ndo ŋginaig le
Farao tuku mbal afu nane Sarai kaŋgermba kumba ka Farao sanaig. Sanaig le nu ismba taŋgo afu kukulniŋgina le pro Sarai tumba Farao tuku wande mbol kinaig le nu taŋge minna.
Minna le Farao nu Sarai tuku garena le nu Abram kigamba agaŋ ndende suŋgomba tuna. Nu agaŋmor suŋgomba sipsip makau kamel doŋki piro mbal turmba Abram tuna le kilna.
Farao nu Abram piyo nuŋe Sarai pinonu tina tukunu Suŋgo nu Farao nuŋe wande tuma mbal turmba ŋaigo siglikina le guaze sugo kile-likinaig.
Taŋanaig le Farao ndek Abram wika kusnana: Ne ame maŋau ye mbolŋge kina? Ndaŋam saka ne naŋe piyo naŋe ta ye ndasayina?
Ne yiŋe kulim ŋga sayina tukunu ye yiŋe pinonu ten. Kile piyo naŋe te tumba kua kaye ŋga Abram sana.
Taŋakina sulumba nu nuŋe mbal saniŋgina le nane Abram mindemba kumba ndinŋge mbilnaig le Abram nale piyo nuŋe ndoŋ agaŋ ndende ŋakmba kilmba kinaik.
